main_text.p: ciales, pertinentes nimirum ad certos ordines; nempe vxores, maritos; liberos, parentes; ser-vos, dominos.

In capite iii, praecedunt exhortationes generales seu communes, usque ad v. 18. deinde sequuntur speciales, usque ad v. 2. capitis quarti: unde perspicitur, primum illius capitis versiculum non recte ab hoc capite avulsum esse.

Capite igitur iv. v. 2. redit ad exhortationes generales, usque ad v. 7. inde commendat eis Tychicum & Onesimum, & alios nonnullos: ex quibus duos illos tunc ad ipsos mittebat, caeterorum autem verbis eos salutat, usque ad v. 15. Deinde iu-bet certos quosdam verbis suis salutari, epistolam hanc cum Laodicensibus communicari, & aliam quandam ex Laodicea scriptam, ab ipsis legi, tum Archippum officij studiose faciendi admoneri: usque ad v. 18. Postremo salutatione sua ad-scripta, vincula sua precibus ipsorum commendat.
main_text.head: SYNOPSIS

page.notes: The first line is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The Roman numeral "iii" is printed as "111" and "iv" as "1 v", which I have read as iii and iv; both are doubtful. Marked [?] not applied since the readings are fairly clear. The heading SYNOPSIS is set in spaced capitals near the foot and is treated as a title above a passage. The right edge shows cut-off marginal notes from the adjacent page, which are not transcribed.
